question: ‘Sakewa’ is a religious festival celebrated in the state of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘Sakewa’ is a religious festival celebrated in the state of **Sikkim**__.
 
• Sakewa is celebrated as a tribute to mother nature.
 
• It is an annual festival celebrated **twice a year** and is distinguished by two names Ubhauli and Udhauli.
 
• ‘Sakewa’ is also known under the titles Bhoomi Puja or Chandi Puja or worship of land.
 
• It is celebrated by the **Kirat Rais community.**
 
• It is marked with the performing of puja where prayers are offered to the Supreme Power for Peace and Protection and for the wellbeing of all the living and non-living things of the universe.
 
• The rituals for this festival are performed in an open space.
 
• Dancers imitate the movements and sounds of birds, beasts and nature.
